title: Inflammatory arthritis
summary: Inflammatory arthritis (rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, etc.) with persistent inflammation/deformity affecting major peripheral joints causing inability to ambulate effectively or perform fine/gross movements, OR ankylosis of dorsolumbar/cervical spine, OR repeated manifestations with marked functional limitation.

children.criterion: Persistent inflammation or deformity in major peripheral weight-bearing joints with inability to ambulate effectively, OR in major peripheral joints in each upper extremity with inability to perform fine and gross movements
Persistent inflammation or deformity in major weight-bearing joints OR major upper extremity joints
Inability to ambulate effectively OR inability to perform fine/gross movements
Inability to ambulate effectively (extreme limitation in walking) due to weight-bearing joint involvement
Inability to perform fine and gross movements effectively in upper extremities
Inflammation or deformity in major joint(s) plus involvement of two or more organs/body systems with one at moderate severity and constitutional symptoms
Inflammation or deformity of major joints
Involvement of two or more organs/body systems with at least one at moderate severity
Two constitutional symptoms (severe fatigue, fever, malaise, weight loss)
Ankylosing spondylitis with fixation of dorsolumbar or cervical spine OR fixation at angle producing functional limitation
Ankylosing spondylitis with fixation of dorsolumbar or cervical spine at 45° or more of flexion measured from vertical position
Fixation of dorsolumbar or cervical spine at 30° or more (but less than 45°) of flexion AND involvement of two or more organs/body systems with one at moderate severity
Repeated manifestations with constitutional symptoms AND marked limitation
Marked limitation in ADLs, social functioning, or completing tasks in timely manner
